reasons: significance_rule=major_disruption_two_member_states: severe service disruption across two or more Member States

completed_actions: Isolated the affected segment and restored the impacted function from a clean replica.
Rotated every credential in the affected scope and validated detections against a regression test set.
mitigation_status.residual_risk: Trust-store update propagation remains a single-failure-mode dependency on the upstream provider; remediation tracked under the next quarterly review.
mitigation_status.root_cause: An upstream provider's certificate-rotation procedure failed to update the downstream trust store within the documented window; the resulting trust failure cascaded into the dependent settlement function.
